bio.text: Tamara Lesnar, of Grenville, is the Libertarian candidate for South Dakota secretary of state in 2026.
According to South Dakota Searchlight's voter guide, Lesnar formerly served as a compliance officer at the Chicago Mercantile Exchange.
Lesnar was the Libertarian candidate for U.S. Senate in South Dakota in 2022, receiving 4% of the vote.

sources.title: Musk DOGE cuts motivate former U.S. Senate candidate to run again
